reviews.title:
5.0 out of 5 stars







  
  
    Preventive Treatment
reviews.review:
My septic tank has worked well for a long time. It is pumped about  every 8 years.  I use an enzyme treatment, including this one, once a year during summer when the biological activity is higher.  I also use monthly tablets of bacteria.  The enzymes can speed up the work of the bacteria by making more readily decomposeable organic matter.  Whether this product is better than the competitors, I can't say, but they do appear to work.  Even if they don't save you money from more frequent pumping, they are better for the overall system.  The septic tank is a source of nutrients to nearby trees and plants around the house.  Less pumping means richer soils.  Septic systems do not use any energy we need to supply by electricity. When the septic tank is pumped, the contents go to treatment facilities that do use electrical energy. The nutrients that remain after treatment go to the rivers and are more widely distributed, supporting plant life along the path of the water.

reviews.title:
5.0 out of 5 stars







  
  
    Stopped the smell and no more standing water
reviews.review:
Started seeing effluent on the surface near the riser and manhole cover. Limited flushes (only the toilet goes into septic, only septic TP and only human waste goes in), requested our young boys pee outside and poured every septic product into potty. Nothing helped and there was always water leaking out. An EPA nightmare.Knew we had failed lines as they were put in by my husband's dad in 1977 (hubby remembers his dad digging the trenches and laying the lateral lines which are terra cotta and the holding tank is made of asphault).  Very old system!  I met the hubby and moved in to the old home in 2005. Didn't know we had septic until 2014 (when it was pumped and septic guy said, "I'm shocked you haven't had more problems").  That was the beginning of our troubles.Conducted a ton of research (I now know so much about septic tanks, I feel that I have a backup career) and came across this product. Reviews on Amazon were stellar. Ordered 2 containers and poured them in. Oh man, does this stuff stink! Per the directions, pour 2 batches in and then follow up with 2 more the next week then 1 every other week for 4 weeks. I'm on application #3.  Will be putting another treatment in this weekend.  I plan on adding more than recommended because I know I have an old system and it needs help.Since starting the treatment, there has been no surfacing effluent, the smell around the manhole cover is gone and the dirt that used to be consistently wet is drying. I don't feel comfortable yet to resume flushing after just tinkle. Hoping that time and more treatments will get me to that spot. For now, this will be the only septic product I purchase.Would highly recommend to anyone who has a healthy or failing septic.  $15.00/ dose is a small investment for your precious septic.******************************************Update 10-4-2016************************************Still no sign of surface effluent or stink.  If it weren't for the rain, would be bone dry.  So very happy with this product!  Adding 2 more containers this weekend to keep the good bacteria going.
